name: Worrel S. Lee Jr.
role: MBA candidate focused on data analytics, research, and business strategy.
heroIntro: I’m Worrel S. Lee Jr., an MBA candidate using data, structured research, and business judgment to turn complex questions into decisions people can act on.
aboutHeading: Curious by practice. Practical by design.
aboutParagraphs: My work sits where data, organizations, and decisions meet. I am developing a portfolio that reflects both technical range and the ability to connect analysis with a clear business question.

As an MBA candidate, I approach analytics as more than a modeling exercise. I consider stakeholders, operating constraints, risk, and the choices a team will need to make. That perspective shapes work ranging from a large-scale renewable energy project management case to predictive analytics and segmentation studies.

My professional research with the DFPS ACE Analytical Projects Team examines initial CANS domains as potential indicators of reduced placement stability within 24 months. Public materials on this site intentionally stay at the approved, non-confidential level.
